description.value:
A webbing harness and chest rig over a padded canvas shell — pouches for magazines, a loop for the machete, a ring for the lantern. Scouts and rig crews wear it because it keeps everything where the hands already know to find it; the padding is almost incidental, and still better than nothing.

No signature. Rattles if you run.

⚙️ Mechanical Effects

  • Armor: Medium
  • Defense: Guard +4, Evasion +4
  • Requires: Bracing (trained)
  • Tier: IV
  • Cost: 190 Nonlethal marks

⟡ Crowned (+3). Keyed to a true name. It will not be sold.

  • +3 on each of its defense bonuses → Guard +4, Evasion +4 (rank-scaled like all armor: Trained half, Proficient full).
  • Grade raises it to Tier IV · soulbound — one bearer, no sale.

item.signature: Twelve pockets, and every one has a reason.
